subject: POC plan, success criteria, and final readout scheduling Acme Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@acmehealth.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@acmehealth.com>
Cc: marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: POC plan & success criteria for Acme Health

Hi Sarah / Tom -

Thanks again for a great discovery call earlier. As promised, below is a concise recap and proposed plan for the POC/trial so we can align on scope, success criteria, ownership, and timing.

Call recap (quick):
- Use case: clinical note summarization + patient Q&A for internal clinician workflow.
- Volume: ~2k notes/day; average context window ~2k tokens; peak 5k tokens.
- Success metric: >85% clinician accuracy on summaries (manual eval set), avg latency <600ms at 95th percentile, and cost target <$0.002/token.

Proposed POC plan (2-week trial):
1) Week 0 - Onboarding (redwood): environment & test dataset ingest, SOC2 docs shared.
2) Week 1 - Controlled evaluation: run canonical prompts on your eval set, measure accuracy and latency; we'll provide tooling to reproduce runs.
3) Week 2 - Production-sim test: sample live traffic replay, observe latency/cost; final readout and decision.

Owners:
- Acme: Sarah (technical lead), Tom (product sponsor), procurement@acmehealth.com (procurement).
- Redwood: Marissa (CS/eng owner), Marcus (SRE/infra).

Deliverables & success criteria:
- Shared eval harness + results dashboard.
- Signed off on accuracy (>=85%) and performance SLA (95p latency <600ms).
- Cost snapshot and recommended config for Dedicated vs Hosted.

Next steps / asks from Acme:
1) Confirm acceptance of the success criteria above or propose edits.
2) Approve POC start date: target June 21 (two-week window ending July 2).
3) Share the evaluation dataset access instructions (S3 link or secure transfer).

Attaching: acme_poc_plan_v1.pdf - includes prompts, test plan, and minimal data access checklist.

If that looks good I'll schedule the onboarding call (30m) and loop in Marcus for infra prep.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0172

From: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@acmehealth.com>, procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC plan & success criteria for Acme Health

Thanks Marissa - appreciate the clear plan. A couple quick items from our side:

- The success criteria look reasonable; we might tighten the latency target depending on replay load, but start with your numbers.
- Our security team needs SOC2 evidence and a short questionnaire answered before we start. Can you attach the SOC2 package?
- Execs want the final readout the week of July 5 instead of July 2 (availability). Can we shift the final decision meeting to July 7 or July 8?
- Also need a rough procurement-level cost estimate (range) for both Hosted API and Dedicated options for a 6-month pilot if the POC is successful.

If you can send SOC2 and a cost snapshot, we'll route to procurement and lock dates.

Tom
Director, Product - Acme Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@acmehealth.com>, Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@acmehealth.com>
Cc: marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com, rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC plan & success criteria for Acme Health

Tom - thanks. Attaching the SOC2 package (redwood_soc2_evidence.zip) and a short completed security questionnaire.

We can absolutely accommodate the final readout the week of July 5. Proposed updated timeline:
- POC start: June 22
- Controlled eval: Jun 23-29
- Production-sim & wrap: Jun 30-Jul 6
- Final readout & exec decision: Jul 7 (propose 11:00am PT) - we're flexible on date/time.

Procurement-level cost snapshot: I've included a 1-page table in the POC plan (hosted vs dedicated, ballpark). Marcus will follow up with more precise Dedicated sizing.

Action items for you: share an S3 link or grant a temporary workspace for the eval set, and confirm whether procurement needs a separate vendor packet or if the SOC2 + invoice template suffices.

I'll schedule the onboarding call for next week once I get confirmation on start date and dataset access.

Best,
Marissa

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Internal - POC infra checklist & runbook for Acme Health

Marissa / Rishi -

I pulled together a short runbook for the trial and infra checklist. Highlights:
- Allocate a 1-GPU Dedicated slot for the controlled eval to ensure consistent latency.
- Pre-warm KV caches with representative prompts.
- Enable prefix caching for repeated bodies.
- Start a controlled traffic replay job (we'll need the eval dataset in S3 or internal bucket).
- Instrument token-level cost and 95p latency tracing; publish to the shared dashboard.

I’ve attached runbook_trial_onboarding.md with exact CLI steps and the sample prompt set. We should also prepare a 15-min demo for the exec readout showing before/after summary quality and the evaluation dashboard.

Marcus
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 16:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Internal - POC infra checklist & runbook for Acme Health

Thanks Marcus - can confirm we can allocate the Dedicated slot Jun 22- Jul 6 for the trial window. I'll schedule a short sync with Marcus to walk through the pre-warm steps and validate cost telemetry.

Note for procurement: I'll draft a concise cost memo (hosted vs dedicated) that Marissa can share with Acme procurement. Marissa - I'll need the expected QPS and token distribution to finalize numbers.

Rishi
VP, Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com

From: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@acmehealth.com>, procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2027 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC plan, success criteria, and final readout scheduling - Acme Health

Marissa - quick confirmation from our side.

- We've received the SOC2 package and the POC plan - thank you.
- Data access: we'll share an S3 presigned URL by EOD Monday (Jun 5 was a typo; means Jul 5 in our calendar).
- Exec readout: moved to Jul 7 at 11:00am PT (confirmed). CEO and VP of Clinical Ops will attend; they want a short decision window and procurement has asked for the cost memo before the readout.
- Decision process: if the POC meets the success criteria (accuracy + latency), the execs will greenlight a 6-month pilot. Procurement will follow with a standard PO; we may need an SOW for Dedicated sizing.

Can your team ensure the cost memo and the short 10-slide readout deck are available by Jul 6 COB so execs can review before the meeting?

Tom Nguyen
Director, Product - Acme Health
